patterns.label: AI agent workflow system
patterns.description: Agents, skills, prompts, tools, governance, and handoffs that work together as a repeatable AI workflow.

patterns.label: Evaluation and contract system
patterns.description: Tests, evaluations, schemas, golden cases, and validators that prove behavior and keep agents aligned.

patterns.label: Knowledge graph and retrieval system
patterns.description: Ontology, taxonomy, graph, retrieval, context-pack, and index assets that help agents find and connect the right things.

patterns.label: Governed learning loop system
patterns.description: Lessons, handoffs, asset-use feedback, governance gates, and review loops that improve future agent behavior.

patterns.label: Asset-use pay-forward loop
patterns.description: A before-use and after-use workflow that records how any digital asset was found, used, upgraded, blocked, valued, and safely handed forward to future agents.
positive_signals: before-use expectation and after-use result fields
parts used, parts not used, difficulties, and upgrades
reuse-when, avoid-when, pay-forward, and next-agent-action guidance
candidate-only safety boundary for external or repo-local feedback
missing_evidence: paired before-use and after-use records for the same asset
reviewed examples across multiple asset types
calibrated impact on current score and ceiling ranges
curated rejection examples showing unsafe or unhelpful feedback

patterns.label: Route-isolated evaluation harness
patterns.description: Routing, chunking, form classification, context packets, scorecards, and gold cases that evaluate different asset forms without mixing authority boundaries.

patterns.label: Agent and skill graph system
patterns.description: Agents, skills, capability registries, tool routes, handoffs, and graph relationships that let future agents discover and compose the right capabilities.

patterns.label: Boundary and contamination firewall
patterns.description: Rules, validators, or workflows that prevent generated candidates, retrieved context, or external assets from overriding source authority.

patterns.label: Proposal-to-promotion workflow
patterns.description: Candidate proposals, review gates, promotion logs, validators, and rollback paths that turn observations into reviewed changes only after human approval.

patterns.label: Load-bearing decision review system
patterns.description: A governed workflow that classifies high-impact software, roadmap, schema, scoring, governance, dependency, and automation decisions by risk tier before they shape downstream repos or future agents.
positive_signals: fresh-eyes red-team or premortem review template
rollback, kill criteria, and bounded A/B comparison language
reviewed learning rule surfaced by preflight or midflight
tests or governance checks that prevent silent bypass
missing_evidence: measured reduction in downstream rework or false-positive defaults
fresh-eyes review records for the highest-risk decisions
human-reviewed threshold for when ceremony becomes too heavy

patterns.label: Frontier signal intake loop
patterns.description: Research, literature, watch items, external signals, and review gates that surface new ideas without automatically importing them as truth.

patterns.label: Gold set and review packet system
patterns.description: Gold cases, expected outputs, review packets, labels, and scoring rubrics that make future evaluation and calibration repeatable.

patterns.label: Duplicate and variant preservation system
patterns.description: Exact identity, near-duplicate, variant, delta, and archive lineage evidence that preserves similar assets while making their differences reviewable.
positive_signals: chunk, shingle, fingerprint, or hash evidence

patterns.label: Model, algorithm, or forecasting system
patterns.description: Algorithms, scoring models, forecasters, simulations, optimization models, or frontier math assets paired with tests/data.
positive_signals: model, algorithm, forecast, predict, or optimize language

patterns.label: Security and governance gate system
patterns.description: Policies, hooks, tests, secret handling, prompt-injection defenses, and review gates that let assets scale safely.
positive_signals: pre-push, policy, secret, or prompt-injection language

patterns.label: Asset cluster delta
patterns.description: Near-duplicate or variant assets compared as a cluster with shared core, strengths, neutral differences, and weaker parts.
positive_signals: same need solved in multiple repos

patterns.label: Semantic evolution grading system
patterns.description: A deterministic workflow that separates behavior-relevant evolution from copy, fixture, formatting, path, and metadata noise across asset families.
positive_signals: semantic evolution or version lineage language
explicit scoring methodology and grade registry
candidate graph edges for evolved_from, semantic_variant_of, noise_variant_of, or lineage_evidence_for
tests proving semantic changes are not confused with fixture or formatting churn

patterns.label: Asset use instance
patterns.description: A specific before-use or after-use record showing how an asset was found, used, upgraded, blocked, or valued.
missing_evidence: curation into score or ceiling calibration

rule: Pattern matches are generated candidate evidence. They guide review, scoring calibration, and composite-asset proposals; they do not prove value or source truth.
